summary: Standing Alabama Forestry Commission lookout beside I-22 in Marion County; NHLR-registered 2023. Build date unknown; register elevation conflicts with OSM.

facts.design: Lattice tower with an internal diagonal staircase

events.note: Registered March 5, 2023 as US 1722, AL 48; nominated by Jason Johns

evidence.supports: stands beside the busy I-22 interstate
evidence.quote: This lookout stands tall next to the busy I-22 interstate.
It has an internal diagonal staircase.

evidence.supports: Alabama Forestry Commission listed for Town Hill

corrections.proposed: unverified; OSM elevation tag reads 220 m
corrections.why: The Register gives 9,137 ft (2,785 m) and the OSM elevation tag gives 220 m. The two differ by more than ten times, so one is wrong, and neither is a survey figure.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Register figure 2,785 m versus OSM 220 m for the same site. The story reports both and treats neither as settled.

notes_for_editor: Build date, staffing, fire history, height and access are absent from every source read. The Register's Location field reads Alabama Forestry Commission, and the Forest Lookouts index names the same agency. The Register's elevation conflicts with the OSM tag; the corrections entry asks for a survey check. A Register site-visit date (5/3/2015) is not used because its format is ambiguous. Search results for Marion County history pages were not read. Photos: none new.
